title: "Foundation and Toolchain"
description: "Keil MDK, J-Link debugging, startup validation, and deterministic GPIO bring-up."
categories: [embedded-systems, firmware, debugging]
---

## Overview

This project established a repeatable Cortex-M33 development workflow, from
toolchain setup and startup code through debugger-based board bring-up.

## Implementation

- Configured the Keil MDK project and device startup flow.
- Validated J-Link programming and source-level debugging.
- Verified GPIO behavior as an early hardware and firmware integration check.

## Outcome

The result is a known-good foundation for adding peripherals and building
firmware features with a reliable debug cycle.
